source: GW2 API /v2/stories(+seasons) + /v2/achievements (Story Journal group); one entry per story EPISODE keyed by storyId, completion detected via the 'Journal: ...' pattern.

episodes.name: 1. Gates of Maguuma
episodes.description: When a roar was heard from somewhere out west, many worried that Scarlet Briar managed to rouse an Elder Dragon during her destructive attack on Lion's Arch. Now, mysterious incursions into Brisban Wildlands have alerted Tyria's heroes to a new threat reaching across its frontiers to tear at its foundations.

episodes.name: 2. Entanglement
episodes.description: Treachery and tragedy led Tyria's heroes on a chase across the frontiers of the Maguuma Wastes and landed them at the doorstep of their former adversary. What has Taimi been able to learn from her investigation, and who's been watching from atop the mesa above Prospect Valley?

episodes.name: 3. The Dragon's Reach, Part 1
episodes.description: With an Elder Dragon's corruption spreading, the heroes of Tyria set out in an attempt to gather allies to meet this new threat. But with problems of their own close to home, will world leaders add their support or just introduce more challenges?

episodes.name: 4. The Dragon's Reach, Part 2
episodes.description: World leaders are converging for a historic summit in the spreading shadow of Mordremoth's advance. Can you convince uneasy allies to cooperate, or will political turmoil spell Tyria's doom?

episodes.name: 5. Echoes of the Past
episodes.description: As Tyria prepares for war with another Elder Dragon, the search for information becomes paramount. The arcane secrets stashed inside the depths of the Durmand Priory shed some light on your mysterious vision, and also give hope for the future.

episodes.name: 6. Tangled Paths
episodes.description: As the Pact continues its preparations for the fight against Mordremoth, a new opportunity arises. But the search for the Master of Peace ends in tragedy, calling into question the motives of a friend.

episodes.name: 7. Seeds of Truth
episodes.description: To find where Caithe may be now, the Pale Tree suggests returning to where she's been. Retracing your friend's steps across the years will take you down a strange and dark path.

episodes.name: 8. Point of No Return
episodes.description: The memory seeds have led to a cave in the Silverwastes where Caithe once chased after Wynne. Getting into it, however, won't be so easy. Perhaps Ogden Stonehealer at the Durmand Priory will know of a solution.

episodes.name: 1. Prologue: Rally to Maguuma
episodes.description: The Elder Dragon Mordremoth has risen, dominating the Maguuma Jungle and destroying the Pact fleet sent to confront it. Now Tyria's bravest heroes race to find the downed Pact flagship and determine the fates of Marshal Trahearne and Destiny's Edge before the dragon's minions completely colonize the jungle and swarm out to overwhelm all of Tyria.

episodes.name: 2. Torn from the Sky
episodes.description: Take charge of the demoralized and disorganized survivors of the Pact fleet disaster.

episodes.name: 3. Establishing a Foothold
episodes.description: Help the Pact survivors regroup and establish defenses against Mordrem attacks.

episodes.name: 4. The Jungle Provides
episodes.description: Make contact with the local Itzel hylek and secure their help as allies against Mordremoth.

episodes.name: 5. In Their Footsteps
episodes.description: Navigate the jungle and confer with the hylek scouts to pick up Rytlock and Braham's trail.

episodes.name: 6. Prisoners of the Dragon
episodes.description: Storm the Mordrem Guard prison camp, and release the prisoners.

episodes.name: 7. Prized Possessions
episodes.description: Expand your search for Destiny's Edge to include Caithe, who has been spotted nearby with Glint's egg.

episodes.name: 8. City of Hope
episodes.description: Secure Glint's egg in Tarir, the golden city designed and built to safeguard Glint's legacy.

episodes.name: 9. The Predator's Path
episodes.description: Follow the trail of holo-disks left by Taimi in order to catch up with the others.

episodes.name: 10. Strange Observations
episodes.description: The egg is safe in Tarir, but as you search for your friends, the jungle grows even more menacing and steeped in mystery.

episodes.name: 11. Roots of Terror
episodes.description: Summary of Chapter 06

episodes.name: 12. The Way In
episodes.description: Find a way into Rata Novus.

episodes.name: 13. Buried Insight
episodes.description: Find the dragon research lab in the lost city of Rata Novus.

episodes.name: 14. Sign Cutting
episodes.description: Follow the trail Rox left for you so you can reunite with your team.

episodes.name: 15. Bitter Harvest
episodes.description: Explore Mordremoth's stronghold and try to find your friends and expose the jungle dragon's weakness.

episodes.name: 16. Hearts and Minds
episodes.description: Storm Modremoth's stronghold.

episodes.name: 0. Convergence
episodes.description: Five Elder Dragons are dead, and with each death, more magic has been released into Tyria. While most passed to Aurene, the rest vanished. After an exhaustive period of research, Dragon's Watch has finally had a breakthrough.

episodes.name: 1. Old Friends
episodes.description: Accompany Gorrik as he retrieves dragon research from his contact.

episodes.name: 2. Outreach
episodes.description: Prove to the people of Cantha that opening their shores is not a mistake.

episodes.name: 3. Your Kind of People
episodes.description: Search for clues about what the Aetherblades did to Aurene and why they are in Cantha.

episodes.name: 4. Can't Trust a Pirate
episodes.description: Track down the wayward Captain Mai Trin.

episodes.name: 5. The Scenic Route
episodes.description: Pursue the mutineer Ankka to New Kaineng, where Mai Trin believes clues may be found.

episodes.name: 6. The Future in Jade
episodes.description: Hunt down what Ankka was looking for in the Xunlai Jade power plants.

episodes.name: 7. Deepest Secrets
episodes.description: Meet Joon at her reactor to confront her about Soo-Won's hidden presence.

episodes.name: 8. Fallout
episodes.description: Regroup and make a plan to prove your innocence.

episodes.name: 9. To Catch a Spider
episodes.description: Track down Ankka in Echovald Forest with the help of the Kestrels.

episodes.name: 10. Empty
episodes.description: Use Canach's airship to lure out Ankka and put a stop to her machinations.

episodes.name: 11. In the Name of the Law
episodes.description: Meet with Minister Li to present evidence of Ankka's misdeeds.

episodes.name: 12. Weight of the World
episodes.description: Convince Joon to ally with us to stop the Void.

episodes.name: 13. Extraction Point
episodes.description: Ready the extractors in Dragon's End to trap Soo-Won.

episodes.name: 14. The Only One
episodes.description: Purge the Void from Soo-Won.

episodes.name: 15. The Cycle, Reborn
episodes.description: Reflect with your allies on your victory over the Void and what comes next.

episodes.name: 16. What Lies Beneath
episodes.description: As Cantha recovers in the wake of the dragon cycle's end, Gorrik, Rama, and Yao take on a mind-altering investigation into power and treachery at a Jade Brotherhood mining operation.

episodes.name: Interlude: Forward
episodes.description: Following the end of the dragon cycle and a restoration of the magical balance across Tyria, Aurene has been preparing for her role as its guardian, the sole remaining Elder Dragon to maintain stability in the fragile new system that she helped establish. Now, her time to step fully into that role has arrived, and the commander is summoned to talk about their place in her plans.

episodes.name: 1. Out of the Shadows
episodes.description: The events in the war against Mordremoth came with deep consequences.

episodes.name: 2. Rising Flames
episodes.description: Taimi has another task for you; one of extreme importance to the war on the Elder Dragons. Help her with her research as she tries to nail down how best to deal with them.

episodes.name: 3. A Crack in the Ice
episodes.description: Braham has gone after Svanir in the Shiverpeaks. What better opportunity to kill two birds with one stone: recruit him to Dragon's Watch, and find another corrupted sample for Taimi.

episodes.name: 4. The Head of the Snake
episodes.description: Queen Jennah has summoned you to an emergency gathering of the ministry in Divinity's Reach. What are her plans for Kryta, and what role will you play in them?

episodes.name: 5. Flashpoint
episodes.description: Taimi says she's completed her device. Has she found a solution to the Elder Dragon problem?

episodes.name: 6. One Path Ends
episodes.description: Balthazar has gone missing. How does one go about finding a god?

episodes.name: 1. Sparking the Flame
episodes.description: Travel to the Crystal Desert and confront the rampaging war god, Balthazar.

episodes.name: 2. Blazing a Trail
episodes.description: Establish your noble intentions with the people of Amnoon.

episodes.name: 3. Night of Fires
episodes.description: Searching for Balthazar's whereabouts.

episodes.name: 4. The Sacrifice
episodes.description: Confronting the god of fire has unintended consequences.

episodes.name: 5. Crystalline Memories
episodes.description: Travel to Glint's lair in search of the weapon mentioned in Vlast's memories.

episodes.name: 6. Hallowed Ground
episodes.description: Travel through the Tomb of Primeval Kings to find entrance into the Mists in order to seek an audience with the gods.

episodes.name: 7. Facing the Truth
episodes.description: Confront the gods and learn the truth about Balthazar.

episodes.name: 8. The Way Forward
episodes.description: Search the desert for answers.

episodes.name: 9. The Departing
episodes.description: Explore the lost ruins of Kesho for answers about the Forgotten and Glint's Legacy.

episodes.name: 10. Enemy of My Enemy
episodes.description: Deceive Palawa Joko's military into battle against Balthazar.

episodes.name: 11. Beast of War
episodes.description: Stop Balthazar's campaign to destroy Kralkatorrik.

episodes.name: 12. To Kill a God
episodes.description: Defeat Balthazar.

episodes.name: 13. Small Victory (Epilogue)
episodes.description: Balthazar is dead, but bigger problems may be on the horizon.

episodes.name: Prologue: The Tyrian Alliance
episodes.description: Nations of Tyria come together in a historic meeting.

episodes.name: 11. Trial and Error
episodes.description: The commander, Caithe, and Malice track down the Durmand Priory's missing titan expert.

episodes.name: 12. Battle's Eve
episodes.description: Stoic Alder invites delegates from the Tyrian Alliance to the battle's eve feast.

episodes.name: 13. Balrior Peak
episodes.description: The commander and their allies climb Mount Balrior to track down the titans.

episodes.name: 14. Into the Valley of Shadow
episodes.description: The commander travels to the outskirts of Bava Nisos to uncover the long-ruined city's menacing past.

episodes.name: 15. A Legacy Damned
episodes.description: The commander pursues Mabon's essence.

episodes.name: 16. Penance for the Past
episodes.description: The essence of Mabon guides the commander toward the gates of Bava Nisos.

episodes.name: 17. Forced Entry
episodes.description: Rash decisions are made, leading the wayfinder into the heart of Bava Nisos, and face-to-face with the truths that await...

episodes.name: 18. A Titanic Undertaking
episodes.description: Entering the heart of Bava Nisos, the wayfinder and their allies are confronted by Saevus Saxum, the massive titan that has become one with the city he once helped bring to ruin.

episodes.name: 19. Salvation's Cost
episodes.description: Faced with the difficult task of releasing the White Mantle spirits tied to the Mists gate, the wayfinder must locate touchstones that can free the spirits from their eternal torment.

episodes.name: 9. On the Threshold
episodes.description: The commander ventures deeper into the island of Castora in pursuit of the Inquest.

episodes.name: 10. Within Your Grasp
episodes.description: The team attempts to catch up with the mysterious Director Vloxx.

episodes.name: 11. Divitium Nava
episodes.description: The commander and Canach build a device to narrow Vloxx's lead.

episodes.name: 12. A Bold Strategy
episodes.description: The team turns to an enemy for aid.

episodes.name: 13. So It Is Written
episodes.description: A hindered ally returns to the field.

episodes.name: Prologue: Bound by Blood
episodes.description: Dragon's Watch travels to the Blood Legion homelands at the invitation of Imperator Bangar Ruinbringer to commemorate Kralkatorrik's defeat with an all-legion rally.

episodes.name: 1. Whisper in the Dark
episodes.description: The commander and allies rush to Bjora Marches in pursuit of Bangar as he attempts to subjugate Jormag. But from the moment they arrive, their progress is halted by the vicious Sons of Svanir and mysterious whispers that threaten to unravel them.

episodes.name: 2. Shadow in the Ice
episodes.description: When Braham goes missing in the hunt for Rytlock and Crecia, the commander travels west to find him. Beyond the door in the mountains lies a long-forgotten lake remembered only in norn legend, home to the terrifying source of the whispers plaguing the Far Shiverpeaks...

episodes.name: Visions of the Past: Steel and Fire
episodes.description: Harnessing the Scrying Pool, the commander experiences a vision of the past that sheds light on the forces marshaling in the north.

episodes.name: 3. No Quarter
episodes.description: Mass defections to Bangar's army have resulted in a charr civil war that will destabilize the legions and thwart efforts to contain the Ice Dragon's awakening. Head to Drizzlewood Coast and quell the insurgency before all is lost.

episodes.name: 4. Jormag Rising
episodes.description: With the arrival of the Frost Legion, the charr civil war is intensifying. And the ice dragon has taken notice.

episodes.name: 5. Champions
episodes.description: Rallying their allies, the commander defends Tyria from the march of two dragons in the thrilling climax of the Icebrood Saga.

episodes.name: 1. Daybreak
episodes.description: Kralkatorrik is on the loose and Aurene is missing. But before you can deal with your dragon problems, Amnoon needs your help.

episodes.name: 2. A Bug in the System
episodes.description: A scientist in the mysterious Inquest facility known as Rata Primus appears to hold the key to stopping Palawa Joko's vengeful invasion of Tyria, but infiltrating the enemy's stronghold will prove challenging.

episodes.name: 3. Long Live the Lich
episodes.description: As the Scarab Plague threatens the Free City of Amnoon, Joko's plans are revealed in all their horrific splendor. Put an end to them.

episodes.name: 4. A Star to Guide Us
episodes.description: Palawa Joko is gone for good, and Elona can finally begin to rebuild. But when a leadership summit in Jahai is unexpectedly interrupted, Elona finds itself at the center of yet another crisis.

episodes.name: 5. All or Nothing
episodes.description: When the details of Glint's legacy are revealed, the commander and Aurene must prove their trust for one another and prepare their allies for the battle of their lives: bringing down the Crystal Dragon.

episodes.name: 6. War Eternal
episodes.description: Following their catastrophic loss in Thunderhead Keep, the commander's allies gather to honor the fallen. For them, a single question lingers: What now?

episodes.name: 1. Flame and Frost
episodes.description: Refugees begin to arrive from the north, bearing tales of outlandish raiders. The commander rallies to the aid of new allies and begins to uncover traces of a threat to all of Tyria.

episodes.name: 2. Sky Pirates
episodes.description: In Lion's Arch, a festival is announced to celebrate the dragon's defeat. The commander arrives for the opening ceremony, but is soon plunged into a darker investigation...

episodes.name: 3. Clockwork Chaos
episodes.description: Queen Jennah announces a new celebration in Divinity's Reach, but strange machinations are afoot.

episodes.name: 4. The Tower of Nightmares
episodes.description: In Kessex Hills, evil is brewing. Responding to a missive from Kasmeer, the commander finds the land ravaged by a dark tower looming out of the lake...

episodes.name: 5. The Battle for Lion's Arch
episodes.description: As the mysterious Scarlet Briar's schemes reach their climax, the commander and their allies gather in defense of Tyria.

episodes.name: Prologue: Uncertain Times
episodes.description: The commander finds themselves with no shortage of things they could do, but at the same time, they are not feeling a pull toward any distinct purpose.

episodes.name: 1. Commander without a Cause
episodes.description: The commander is called into action, giving them a much-needed reprieve from an otherwise relaxed vacation.

episodes.name: 2. Hell Breaks Loose
episodes.description: The commander is thrust into danger!

episodes.name: 3. Mother of Stars
episodes.description: The commander gets to know the mysterious Astral Ward and aids in their efforts to rescue Dagda, the Wizard of the Celestial.

episodes.name: 4. Voices beyond the Veil
episodes.description: The commander continues to aid the Astral Ward and the Rift Hunters as they fight back against the Kryptis.

episodes.name: 5. The Missing Facet
episodes.description: The commander and their new allies march on the Wizard's Tower.

episodes.name: 6. Tower of Secrets
episodes.description: With Dagda and Lyhr saved, the commander finally finds their footing in this strange side of Tyria.

episodes.name: 7. Mabon's Fate
episodes.description: The commander, now dubbed the "wayfinder," must track down and attempt to save Mabon before it's too late.

episodes.name: 8. Into the Obscure
episodes.description: The wayfinder and the Astral Ward continue in their march against the Kryptis; Amnytas is in danger.

episodes.name: 9. The World Spire
episodes.description: The wayfinder and their Astral Ward allies march against the World Spire in search of Isgarren.

episodes.name: 10. Treachery
episodes.description: The commander faces Cerus. Hopefully for the last time.

episodes.name: 11. Duress
episodes.description: The wayfinder is called back into action by Peitha and the Wizard's Court.

episodes.name: 12. The Survivors
episodes.description: The wayfinder finds their bearings in Nayos, the Realm of Dreams.

episodes.name: 13. Heitor's Gate
episodes.description: The wayfinder confronts Heitor, one of Eparch's generals, and frees the outer reaches of Nayos.

episodes.name: 14. The War Council
episodes.description: The wayfinder helps Peitha weaken King Eparch's control.

episodes.name: 15. Forced Hand
episodes.description: The wayfinder seeks a powerful ally.

episodes.name: 16. Eventide's March
episodes.description: The wayfinder deals with Queen Labris.

episodes.name: 17. Desperate Measures
episodes.description: The wayfinder gathers with allies and prepares for the assault on Zakiros.

episodes.name: 18. The Eleventh Hour
episodes.description: The wayfinder ascends the Spire of Dreams.

episodes.name: 19. Sovereign of Nayos
episodes.description: The wayfinder witnesses the signing of a historic treaty.
